_comment: How an inflicted meteor storm climbs the tiers, dial by dial (design 5.2).
Difficulty you can answer: anything in `agesandtheart:seals_wounds` is immune to a blast worth using, and
being properly indoors is free. `often` is how often a storm gathers and `long` how long it lasts, and how
many bodies it drops follows `long` alone, since every body is a light drawn in the sky. `power` is how
hard they land -- speed and blast -- which is what can take a roof off. A dial bought in full is worth
what `teeming` is to a written storm. Harmful throughout.
Leans nowhere: the sky falls on any climate.
